summary: County pages read: primitive only, $10 a night, first come, 14 days in 30, vault toilets, dump, non-potable water, six pads designed for horse trailers plus corrals. Fees/booking/hookups/facilities now manual. Lakeview stands (pads ~150 m from the shore across open prairie). Pin ok. Horse-camp question flagged. Phone suggested.
flags: CRITERIA (horse camp?): the county says 'The campground features six parking pads which are designed for horse trailers. There are also corrals and tethers for horses.' Imagery shows six angled pull-through spurs off one gravel lane (~46.9727,-98.7734) with a small pen to the northwest; the tree-row lanes east of it carry picnic shelters, and no separate general-camping loop is described. The county presents Parkhurst as a general recreation area (camping, boating, fishing) open to all at $10, and HHS licenses it for 80 units, so these read as general sites sized for horse trailers rather than a horse-only camp - but the horse pads and any general camping are not physically distinct. Reviewer decides (Little Missouri SP dropped vs Jorgen's Hollow kept).

WATERFRONT: lakeview stands. The pull-off pads sit on open prairie ~130-160 m northeast of the Pipestem Lake shore (nearest shore ~46.9718,-98.7752) with only scattered trees between - a view, not on-water (beyond ~50 m). No seasonal sites (FCFS, 14-day limit).
